framework.name: RBI Cyber Resilience and Digital Payment Security Controls for Non-bank PSOs (2024)
framework.description: For authorised non-bank payment system operators: payment aggregators, prepaid payment instrument (wallet) issuers, card networks, ATM and white-label ATM operators, Bharat Bill Pay operating units, TReDS, cross-border money transfer operators and others. Large PSOs had to comply by 1 April 2025, medium ones by 1 April 2026 and small ones by 1 April 2028. PSOs must also make their payment gateways, technology providers and vendors follow these controls.

requirements.title: Extend controls to ecosystem partners
requirements.guidance: Make unregulated entities in your payment chain (payment gateways, technology providers, vendors) follow these Directions through agreements and a Board-approved policy.

controls.title: Vendor contracts and data processing agreements

requirements.title: Board oversight and IT sub-committee
requirements.guidance: The Board oversees information security and cyber risk; it may delegate to a sub-committee headed by a member with security experience, meeting at least quarterly.

controls.title: Regulator-mandated IT governance committees and CISO independence
Board-level oversight of IT and cyber risk

requirements.title: Board-approved information security policy
requirements.guidance: An information security policy covering roles, risk identification and management and training, reviewed annually.

requirements.title: Board-approved Cyber Crisis Management Plan
requirements.guidance: A separate Cyber Crisis Management Plan, referring to CERT-In, NCIIPC and IDRBT guidance.

requirements.title: Accountable senior executive (CISO)
requirements.guidance: A senior executive with security expertise, such as a CISO, is accountable for the policy and the cyber resilience framework.

requirements.title: KRIs, KPIs and reporting of assessments
requirements.guidance: Define key risk and performance indicators monitored by the Board sub-committee, and table audit and VA/PT reports at its next meeting.

controls.title: Security metrics and monitoring of the programme

requirements.title: Cyber risk assessment before launches and major changes
requirements.guidance: Assess cyber risk before launching products or making major changes.

requirements.title: Asset inventory, data flows and end-of-life tracking
requirements.guidance: Keep asset registers and data-flow diagrams and track end of support.

requirements.title: Identity and access management
requirements.guidance: Least privilege, MFA for privileged accounts, default credentials changed before go-live, session timeouts and removable media controls.

requirements.title: Network security, SOC and SIEM
requirements.guidance: A SOC with SIEM correlation, anti-malware, layered boundary defences, segmentation and device checks before network access.

requirements.title: Application lifecycle security
requirements.guidance: Secure SDLC, database layer segregated from other tiers, and source code (or escrow) for critical procured applications.

requirements.title: Code review, VA and PT at least annually and before deployment
requirements.guidance: Source code review, VA and PT at least annually in authenticated mode, vendor certificates for code you don't own, security audit before any deployment, and recurring findings reported to the sub-committee.

requirements.title: Vendor risk and independent assurance
requirements.guidance: Manage vendor risk under the outsourcing framework, protect against infiltration from vendor environments, and get independent assurance for vendors in critical processes.

controls.title: Outsourcing register, sub-contracting and exit plans

requirements.title: Payment data stored in India
requirements.guidance: Comply with the RBI requirement to store payment system data only in India (circular of 6 April 2018).

controls.title: Payment system data stored only in India

requirements.title: Data security, PCI DSS and half-yearly restore tests
requirements.guidance: Data leak prevention, an ISMS, encryption in transit and at rest, PCI DSS for stored card data, and backup restore tests at least half-yearly.

controls.title: Encryption at rest and key management

requirements.title: Patch and change management
requirements.guidance: Apply critical patches immediately and test changes outside production first.

requirements.title: Report incidents to RBI within 6 hours
requirements.guidance: A Board-approved incident response mechanism with forensics; report incidents to RBI in the Annex 1 format within 6 hours of detection, and to CERT-In.

requirements.title: BCP, DR in another seismic zone, half-yearly drills
requirements.guidance: Scenario-based BCP reviewed annually, RTO/RPO aligned (near-zero RPO aspired), DR site in a different seismic zone, DR drills at least half-yearly.

requirements.title: API security
requirements.guidance: Authenticate and authorise API calls, protect message integrity and availability, and detect anomalies.

requirements.title: Training with minimum scores
requirements.guidance: Periodic training for employees and vendors; restrict access for staff below a benchmark score.

requirements.title: Cloud policy and annual CSP audit
requirements.guidance: A cloud operation policy, data segregation and annual independent audit of cloud providers.

requirements.title: MFA for debits, real-time fraud monitoring, 24x7 desk, 5-year logs
requirements.guidance: MFA for electronic debits unless relaxed, real-time fraud monitoring, a manned 24x7x365 desk for fraud complaints and law enforcement, audit logs kept at least five years, anti-phishing and rogue-app takedown.

controls.title: Customer authentication for payments and sensitive changes
Mobile and web payment application security
Centralised logging with retention in India

requirements.title: Risk alerts, masked notifications and fraud flagging
requirements.guidance: Online alerts on failed transactions, velocity and geo-location; masked account and card details; merchant name (not the gateway) in messages with the OTP at the end; customers can flag fraud in the app or website.

requirements.title: Mobile app controls and 12-hour cooling period
requirements.guidance: Device binding and re-binding after long non-use, inactivity timeout, lockout after failed logins, block while remote-access apps run, and a 12-hour cooling period after a mobile number or email change.

controls.title: Customer authentication for payments and sensitive changes
Mobile and web payment application security

requirements.title: Validated terminals, network limits and 24x7 alerts
requirements.guidance: PCI P2PE and PTS validated terminals, network-level transaction limits and 24x7x365 suspicious-activity alerts to issuers.

requirements.title: PPI alerts in local language and load cooling period
requirements.guidance: OTPs and alerts in the customer's language, and a cooling period before transfers or withdrawals after loading.
